name: roboEVI
group: FAU Erlangen-Nuernberg, SPARC lab (Mathis-Ullrich; Fischer, Karstensen)
target_anatomy: aortic arch / supra-aortic phantom (aortic root, left vertebral V2)
devices_driven: 0.035 in guidewire or 5.2 Fr catheter, one at a time
translation_detail: clamp-relay (two alternating carts with pneumatic membrane grippers, threaded rod, stroke 17.5 mm per cart; leader-follower hand-over)
rotation_detail: stepper through pinion shaft turning the gripper gear (78.4 deg per hand-over)
device_range: 0.035 in wire and 5.2 Fr catheter tested; top-loading for any size
validation_detail: motion tracking with guidewire and catheter; pulsatile vascular phantom, 5 repeats per mode (aortic root / vertebral artery, manual vs robot)
key_numbers: relative tracking error 3.6+-2.2% (translation) and 4.1+-1.6% (rotation); phantom success 90% robot vs 100% manual; unintended branch insertions 8 vs 5; hand-over limited speed 30.4 mm/s, tested up to 19 mm/s
sim_model: none for this robot (group's stEVE/SOFA environment is separate)
